items.b: INDIA'S CUSTOMS BASE FOR GOLD IS $1,500 PER 10 GRAMS. TEN GRAMS IS WORTH $1,432.12
items.t: Notification No. 71/2026-Customs (N.T.), signed 25 August and effective 26 August, raised the tariff value by $93 or 6.6098% from the $1,407 set eleven days earlier. It implies gold at $4,665.52 the ounce against a market of $4,454.40. Duty has been 15% since 13 May, so the gap costs $10.18 per 10 grams, or $1,018.16 the kilogram landed.

items.b: SILVER WAS LEFT AT $2,097 THE KILOGRAM, AND EVERY OTHER LINE IN THE TABLE HELD
items.t: Palm oil, palmolein, soybean oil, brass scrap and areca nuts at $11,574 the tonne were all carried unchanged. Gold was the only tariff value the notification moved. The base stood $10.07 above the metal on the day it was signed and Friday's $150.10 fall took that to $67.88.

items.b: TWO RETAIL COUNTERS PRICED THE SAME FRIDAY 38 POINTS APART
items.t: Chow Tai Fook's mainland counter read 1,348.00 yuan the gram on a live fetch this morning, down 39 or 2.8118% from 28 August. Dubai's published 24-carat rate was 536.75 dirhams. At 6.73084 yuan and the dirham's 3.6725 peg that is $200.2722 and $146.1538 the gram against gold's own $143.2123, or 39.8429% and 2.0540% over. One is a finished-jewellery price, the other a metal rate.

items.b: GSI HAS BEGUN ISSUING PIGEON BLOOD AND ROYAL BLUE REPORTS IN INDIA
items.t: Rapaport reported on 19 August that the laboratory now grants Pigeon Blood for ruby and Royal Blue and Padparadscha for sapphire from Jaipur, Mumbai, New York and Bangkok, the first time in India. Hue, tone and saturation ranges are read under standardised lighting with spectroscopic and colorimetric support, and only untreated stones qualify.

items.b: US CUSTOMS TOOK 875 COUNTERFEIT PIECES OUT OF ONE PARCEL AT INDIANAPOLIS
items.t: The shipment came from Hong Kong and was addressed to a residence in Georgia, carrying Cartier, Tiffany and Van Cleef and Arpels marks among others, with five designer handbags alongside. Retail value if genuine was put at $3.7 million by National Jeweler and Rapaport, an average of $4,228.57 the piece.

items.b: NOTHING TRADED. THE LAB-GROWN REFERENCE MOVED A DOLLAR AND RAPI DID NOT MOVE AT ALL
items.t: Spot has been shut since Friday's 13:00 ET close, so gold holds $4,454.40, silver $66.253, platinum $1,819.00 and palladium $1,405.00. CaratRadar's one-carat lab-grown reference went $701 to $700, its first move in three sessions. RapNet's 1.00ct index held the July point of 3,881.34 for a fourth consecutive fetch.
